scopeNotes: The pinned irc-logs tree contains exactly ten clientlog-* files. All ten raw files were retrieved at the pinned commit; each byte count and locally recomputed Git blob SHA-1 matched the Git tree. Raw SHA-256 values are recorded above.

Only clientlog-1359224026-2.txt (2013-01-26, DH 118818811), clientlog-1359239635-3.txt (2013-01-26, DH 5), and clientlog-1362290293-9.txt (2013-03-03, DH 3301) contain executed DH requests. Only the March DH3301 log contains an executed NEXT request.
The three 16481-byte clientlogs from 2013-01-28, 2013-02-01 and 2013-02-07 contain DH command strings only inside transmitted server-source text, not as executed client requests.
The other nineteen irc-logs entries are channel logs, mainlog.txt, hippo.txt and received1.txt, not additional clientlog-* session traces.

The participant logs' embedded 2013 timestamps are not independently authenticated by their 2024 GitHub archive custody. The January 118818811 session has no signed NEXT payload and no authenticated client identity.
The mainlog's 127.0.0.1 addresses are consistent with the signed protocol's Tor hidden-service instructions and localhost server binding; they do not establish a local self-test.
